sources.title: Tengyu Ma, Lecture Notes for Machine Learning Theory, Chapter 11

author_read_locators.locator: §§11.1–11.2.1, PDF pp. 147–150: general online timing, full-information observation, regret to a best fixed comparator, and oblivious/non-oblivious environment classes.
author_read_locators.disposition: Used as an independent full lecture-note treatment of timing, feedback, and regret. The notes call an adversary adaptive when it may see the current action; this pair follows the controlling plan's finer split and calls that timing reactive, reserving non-anticipating adaptive for losses chosen from pre-action history. No guarantee from these notes is imported.
